column4:
No two modules in the design have the same name.

Each module name shall be prefixed with the project name (e.g. cv32e40p_<module>)

Each module name shall match the file name using the system verilog suffix ".sv" (e.g. cv32e40p_controller module located in cv32e40p_controller.sv file)

Each system verilog file shall contain only one module definition
column7: Not prefixed: vendored C910 (ct_vfdsu_*), E906 (gated_clk_cell), common_cells (lzc, rr_arb_tree), CVA6 (fpu_wrap). Suffix .v: vendored C910/E906 files.
column8: Checked on the design units of the elaborated hierarchy (fpu_wrap and below, with fpnew_pkg): no duplicate name; one unit per file; fpnew modules are prefixed fpnew_.

column4: The design does not mix HDLs.
column8: SystemVerilog only; the vendored C910/E906 files are Verilog-2001, a subset of IEEE 1800. No VHDL.

column4: In IP designs, technology-specific blocks (mainly RAM cells) are accessible and easily replaced by blocks targetting other ASIC or FPGA technologies.
column8: No memory macro and no technology cell in the hierarchy. gated_clk_cell (E906) is a pass-through (assign clk_out = clk_in).

column3: No use of ifdef, ifndef, defines
column4: No ifdef, ifndef or defines used anywhere in RTL
column7: fpnew registers use the common_cells macros `FF, `FFL, `FFLARNC, `FFLNR (registers.svh, with `ifdef VERILATOR / `ifndef NO_SYNOPSYS_FF); assertions use common_cells `ASSERT macros (guards ASSERTS_OFF, COMMON_CELLS_ASSERTS_OFF, SYNTHESIS, not project-named).
column8: No `ifdef/`ifndef/`define in fpnew src, in the vendored C910/E906 files or in fpu_wrap.sv.

column4: No comments in code alluding to potential fixes or changes. Comments include "todo", "tbd", "fixme"
column8: No TODO/TBD/FIXME in fpnew, vendored C910/E906, common_cells (lzc, rr_arb_tree) or fpu_wrap.sv.

column3: No open non-waived RTL bugs in github
column4: No open non-waived issues with both label Component:RTL and Type:Bug
column8: fpnew has no Component:RTL / Type:Bug labels; its bug labels are bug, bug-arithmetic, bug-flags. Open issues with a bug label: #45, #183, both DoesNotGate_v1.0.0. Open without any bug label: #39, #143 (not triaged as bugs). See CVFPU_Design_Issue_Summary.xlsx.

column3: No dependency on external repositories for design
column4: No dependency on external repositories for design
column7: fpnew depends on pulp-platform/common_cells v1.40.0 (Bender), which provides lzc, rr_arb_tree, cf_math_pkg and the register/assertion macros. fpu_wrap comes from openhwgroup/cva6.
column8: C910, E906 and CVW sources are vendored inside the fpnew repository.

column4: Synchronizers shall be implemented with a component module (similar to clock gate) in order for implementation to replace with 2 or 3 flip-flop synchronizer based on technology and MTBF requirements
column8: Single clock domain (clk_i). The C910 internal clocks are gated_clk_cell outputs, which are clk_i (pass-through). No CDC.

column4: Asynchronous inputs have an adequate synchronizer(s).
column8: All data/control inputs are synchronous to clk_i. rst_ni is an asynchronous active-low reset; its deassertion synchronizer is outside the IP, in the integrating system.

column4: Fully synchronous design
column8: All flops are clocked by posedge clk_i (directly or through the pass-through gated_clk_cell).

column4: No delay line (based on propagation time)
column8: No # delay in the elaborated RTL.

column4: No combinational loops
column8: Verilator 5.048 lint reports no UNOPTFLAT (circular combinational logic) warning on the hierarchy; the check was confirmed to fire on a known loop. Reports/Lint/README.md

column4: No multicycle path
column8: No multicycle path is documented in fpnew; not verified by STA (no synthesis/STA in this release).

column4: Only one active clock edge in the design
column8: posedge only; negedge appears only on the active-low async reset.

column4: Gated clocks necessary, clearly identified in the code, in the documentation along with synthesis/STA guidelines.
column8: No effective clock gating: the only clock-gate cell (E906 gated_clk_cell, used by the C910 divider) is a pass-through; fpnew ties its enables (cp0_vfpu_icg_en = 0, cp0_yy_clk_en = 1, pad_yy_icg_scan_en = 0).

column4: Latches may be implemented for large memory elements (such as register files) using a parameter to select between register vs latched design
column8: Verilator 5.048 lint reports no LATCH warning on the hierarchy; the check was confirmed to fire on an incomplete Verilog-2001 always @(...) block as used in the C910 divider. No memory element in the FPU. Reports/Lint/README.md

column4: Only one reset signal in the design
column8: rst_ni only; the C910 cpurst_b is connected to rst_ni in fpnew_divsqrt_th_64_multi.

column4: Same type of reset in the whole design (synchronous/asynchronous, active high/low)
column7: fpnew_divsqrt_th_64_multi: held_result_q/held_status_q are data registers without reset (`FFLNR).
column8: Every reset register uses the asynchronous active-low rst_ni. flush_i is a synchronous functional clear, not a reset.

column4: FSM state register has a reset
column8: fpu_wrap state_q, fpnew_divsqrt_th_64_multi state_q and the C910 control state machines are all reset by rst_ni.

column4: No internal tri-state buffers
column8: No tri-state net or 'z value in the RTL.

column4: A linting tool was used; it reports no error and all outstanding warnings can be waived.
column8: Verilator 5.048 --lint-only -Wall on fpu_wrap in the verified configuration: 0 errors, 494 warnings, each waived with its reason in Reports/Lint/README.md.
